messages.name: Oracle admin
messages.body: A client says they never got their November invoice from the recurring profile.

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: This looks like BUG-2100-02: recurring schedules calculated in local time can skip a cycle when daylight-saving time changes. It is fixed in 2.3.1, which moves schedules to UTC. For now, send the missed invoice by hand from the profile.

messages.name: Oracle admin
messages.body: OK. Please let us know when it's fixed.
